title: Bottleneck block
description: 1×1, 3×3 and 1×1 convolutions (4× expansion) with batch norm plus a 1×1 projection shortcut, as in ResNet-50.
descriptionZh: 1×1、3×3、1×1 卷积（通道扩张 4 倍）带批归一化，加 1×1 投影捷径，同 ResNet-50。

title: Multi-head attention
description: Q, K and V projections split into heads, scaled dot-product softmax, heads merged and an output projection.
descriptionZh: Q、K、V 投影拆成多头，缩放点积后 softmax，合并各头再接输出投影。

title: Residual block
description: Two 3×3 convolutions with batch norm plus a 1×1 projection shortcut; for an identity shortcut, delete it and connect x to the add.
descriptionZh: 两个带批归一化的 3×3 卷积加 1×1 投影捷径；需要恒等捷径时删除捷径，把 x 直接连到加法。

title: Squeeze-and-excitation
description: Global pooling, two linear layers and a sigmoid give one weight per channel, which rescales the input.
descriptionZh: 全局池化、两个线性层和 sigmoid 得到每个通道的权重，再乘回输入。

title: Transformer block
description: Pre-norm: x + attention(LayerNorm(x)), then x + MLP(LayerNorm(x)), with the expanded multi-head attention.
descriptionZh: Pre-LN：x + 注意力(LayerNorm(x))，再 x + MLP(LayerNorm(x))，注意力为展开的多头注意力。

title: U-Net down block
description: 2×2 max pooling halves the resolution, then two 3×3 convolutions with ReLU.
descriptionZh: 2×2 最大池化把分辨率减半，再接两个带 ReLU 的 3×3 卷积。

title: U-Net up block
description: A 2×2 transposed convolution doubles the resolution, the skip connection is concatenated, then two 3×3 convolutions.
descriptionZh: 2×2 转置卷积把分辨率加倍，与跳跃连接拼接，再接两个 3×3 卷积。
